title: 第19章 独闯演武场第20章 这一招名为爆更
content_zh:
演武场上，无数弟子聚集在此地勤练武艺。
数日前，叶离和李熙这两个新人前二的天才打了一场。
无论是战斗的结果，还是执法队流传出的话语，都在这些弟子间掀起了不小的波澜。
但很快，这种趣闻便在残酷的竞争氛围里当做调剂被人遗忘。
毕竟生活无比残酷，这看似劳累的半年，便决定他们一辈子的上限。
习武！三分练，七分吃！
苍龙帮除了这半年帮内管饭，大鱼大肉以外，后续的吃食都要自己购买！
所以若是走出新手期，凭古代的生产力，别说淬体丸，这些混混连饭都吃不起！
普通混混的月例相较于大部分底层来说算是充裕。
可为了维持练武所需的每日肉食，一月便能吃光普通人家小半年的收入。
如果没法获得金钱购买高质量肉食，正常人的食量顶多维持力量不退转！
而“卢岳”，便是苍龙帮一个平平无奇的新人弟子！
他的天资平平，获得的词条也仅仅只是基础的白色词条，只能够增幅10%的力量！
此时距离他加入苍龙帮，已然渡过5个月！
入境的事依旧遥遥无期！
眼看便要在几天之后成为供养帮派的普通帮众了，一桩买卖却主动撞入他的怀里！
不久前，药堂内！
卢岳望着面前绷带缠绕双臂的李熙，挑眉道：“你的意思，要我帮你废了那叶离？”
“不错！”李熙咬牙道：“你已入帮五月有余，收拾个入木五分的叶离绰绰有余！”
“这是自然！”

卢岳理所当然：“那叶离再天才，也才入帮一月，我单手打他都嫌多！”
“不过……我为什么要帮你？”
“那叶离是帮内看重的天才，我将他废了，到时候怪罪下来……”
“不用太严重，两个月内无法动武就好了！”
李熙感受着隐隐作痛的双臂，满脸怨毒之色：“等我伤好后，会亲自讨回！”
“我也是不逊色于叶离的天才，背后更有李家撑腰！”
“等我将叶离亲自整死以后，你们也不用担心报复的事了！”
“事成之后，百两白银奉上！”李熙眼中闪过肉疼道！
听到白银百两，卢岳眼底浮现火热！
那可是他近3年的月例！
最重要的是，若是有了这笔钱，足以支撑他修炼到淬体境！
若是突破，虽然无法成为核心弟子，但境遇也将发生显著的改善！
将叶离打成重伤而不致死，顶多挨执法堂几十杀威棍，一本万利！
“好，这笔交易我做了！”卢岳满口答应下来！
“小心一点，那叶离邪门的很，词条是【机敏过人】，已经学会了帮内给的武功！”
“邪门？一个新人我怕什么？”
……
视角回到演武场。
卢岳有些心不在焉地演练着桩工！
此刻在他周围，正站着两个同样入帮5月的同门。

这是他以10两银子找来助拳的！
绑着袖带的叫高旭，矮一些的叫常顷！
本来卢岳一共找了3人，可另外一人不想掺和这趟浑水，临时跑了。
content_en:
In the martial arts arena, countless disciples gathered here to practice martial arts diligently.
A few days ago, two talented newcomers, Ye Li and Li Xi, had a battle.
Whether it was the result of the battle or the words spread by the law enforcement team, it caused quite a stir among these disciples.
But soon, this anecdote was forgotten as a spice in the cruel competitive atmosphere.
After all, life is extremely cruel, and this seemingly tiring half a year determines the upper limit of their lives.
Practice martial arts! Three points to practice, seven points to eat!
The Canglong Gang will have to buy all the food they eat in the future, except for the big fish and meat for the first half of the year!
So if they get out of the novice stage, with ancient productivity, let alone body tempering pills, these gangsters can't even afford to eat!
The monthly salary of an ordinary gangster is sufficient compared to most of the bottom.
However, in order to maintain the daily meat required for martial arts training, an average family can consume less than half a year's income in one month.
If money is not available to buy high-quality meat, normal people can only eat enough to maintain their strength!
And "Lu Yue" is an ordinary new disciple of the Canglong Gang!
His talent is mediocre, and the entries he obtained are only basic white entries, which can only increase his power by 10%!
At this time, 5 months have passed since he joined the Canglong Gang!
Entry is still far away!
He was about to become an ordinary member of the supporting gang in a few days, but a business deal unexpectedly ran into his arms!
Not long ago, in the medicine hall!
Lu Yue looked at Li Xi with his arms wrapped in bandages in front of him, raised his eyebrows and said, "What do you mean, you want me to help you destroy that Ye Li?"
"Not bad!" Li Xi gritted his teeth and said, "You have been in the gang for more than five months, which is more than enough to take care of Ye Li, who is extremely powerful!"
"It's natural!"
Lu Yue took it for granted: "No matter how talented Ye Li is, he has only been in the gang for a month. It's too much for me to beat him with one hand!"
"But...why should I help you?"
"That Ye Li is a genius valued by the gang. I will destroy him and then I will blame him..."
"It doesn't have to be too serious, just not being able to use force within two months will be fine!"
Li Xi felt the pain in his arms, with a look of resentment on his face: "When I recover from the injury, I will ask for it back in person!"
"I am also a genius who is not inferior to Ye Li, and I have the support of the Li family behind me!"
"After I kill Ye Li myself, you don't have to worry about revenge!"
"When the job is done, I'll give you a hundred taels of silver!" Li Xi said with a flash of pain in his eyes!
Hearing the hundred taels of silver, Lu Yue's eyes were filled with fire!
That’s his monthly record for the past three years!
The most important thing is that if he has this money, it will be enough to support his cultivation to the body tempering realm!
If there is a breakthrough, although you will not be able to become a core disciple, your situation will be significantly improved!
If Ye Li is seriously injured but not killed, he will be beaten to death by dozens of people in the law enforcement hall, and he will make a lot of money!
"Okay, I've made this deal!" Lu Yue agreed wholeheartedly!
"Be careful, that Ye Li is a very good sect, his entry is [extraordinary agility], he has already learned the martial arts given by the gang!"
"Evil? What should I be afraid of as a newcomer?"
…
The perspective returns to the martial arts arena.
Lu Yue practiced pile work absentmindedly!
At this moment, standing around him were two fellow disciples who had also joined the gang in May.
This is what he hired for 10 taels of silver to help him!
The one with cuffs is called Gao Xu, and the shorter one is called Chang Qing!
Originally, Lu Yue found three people in total, but the other one didn't want to get involved in this muddy water and ran away temporarily.
